about: L8-WP01 characterization suites for lane L8 (Train together, federated learning), planset v060 L8 section 4. Each suite pins today's FL behavior at citrate-core a826e441 before an L8 work package changes it: the network state reads (PatronageLedger totalUnits only, FRL rounds inferred from WorkMarket, the today phase), the join and open refusals while payouts are dark, the PatronageLedger-only training reads, the Rust payouts gate on WorkMarket writes and FRL commit/finalize, and the collector safety tests by name. A later L8 PR that changes a pinned behavior replaces the test with a stricter one in a separate commit that says why and names the suite id (supersededBy lists the WPs allowed to). 'protected' is the FL honesty list handed to LQ: never deleted, the test count never drops, the named tests stay declared, and each is replaced only by the stricter test docs/fl/CHARACTERIZATION.md names. LQ runs every suite here on every merge-queue group (npm run test:characterization selects the vitest ones; the cargo one by filter). flRegistry.characterization.test.ts checks all of it.

suites.pins: the FL network state as the webview derives it today: PatronageLedger is read with totalUnits() only (one eth_call, the pinned selector) and FRL rounds are inferred from WorkMarket being absent (networkState.ts:153-168); the phase is 'today' without WorkMarket (phaseFor :116-125); joinIntent and openIntent refuse first while payouts are not open, with the required words (Matches.tsx:50-53, roundDraft.ts:300-306)

training_status and training_reward read PatronageLedger only (roundMergedHash, units, pendingDividendOf at the book's PatronageLedger) and no training write command exists (training.rs:1-7, commands :182, :211); the kit payouts gate under the shipped r1007 profile refuses every WorkMarket write while dark and lets FederatedRoundLedger commitRound and finalize through without a code read (it reads the gate, edits nothing); the eight collector safety tests stay declared by name in fl_collect_tests.rs

this registry lists exactly the L8 suites; each suite file declares exactly the tests listed for it; the cargo file is included where the registry says; each protected suite keeps its count and named tests; docs/fl/CHARACTERIZATION.md names every pinned and protected test with the WP allowed to replace it
